newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.

text.p: These are the main headlines of ther news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkey's president, Suleyman Demirel, arrived for an official visit.

- Welfare Minister Vladimir Makarov says he will stay on in his post until the government parties decide on additional social funds on June 11. Makarov earlier said he would resign in a row over a new pension law.
- Small parties in parliament will block the suggested tightening of the election law.
- President Guntis Ulmanis called on Prime Minister Andris Shkele to simplify naturalisation procedures and lower the naturalisation fee to three lats form the current 30 lats.
